session.warningText: For security, the session ends when there is no activity. {{time}} left. Do you want to continue?
session.limitTitle: The session cannot be extended any further
session.limitText: You have reached the maximum session time. {{time}} left: save what you are doing. Unsaved work on a process is recovered when you sign in again in this browser.

home.title: Home
home.intro: This is what needs your attention today.
home.scope: Only sees data from their organisation ({{org}}).
home.noRole: Your account has no management role. Ask an administrator to assign you one.

attention.title: Needs your attention
attention.failedEmailsSub: {{process}} · review and retry them from Participation.
attention.emptyCensusSub: It cannot be used in a process until it has people.
attention.draftsSub: Complete and schedule them so the invitations are sent.
attention.frozenSub: A scheduled or open process uses them: nobody can be added or removed until it ends.
attention.allGoodSub: No undelivered emails and no empty censuses.

chart.title: Cumulative votes cast per day (open processes, % of the census)
chart.none: Nobody has voted in the open processes yet.
chart.secrecy: Aggregated turnout only, by day and never by time (it protects ballot secrecy). Counts per option are not shown until the tally.

superadmin.title: Organisations on the platform
superadmin.can: create organisations, suspend or reactivate them and assign their administrators.
superadmin.scope: Does not see the censuses, processes, votes or results of any organisation.

admin.title: Your organisation's processes
admin.can: create and schedule processes, follow turnout, publish results and minutes, check traceability, handle GDPR requests and manage API keys.
admin.kpiVotesSub: in open processes, out of {{eligible}} people
admin.kpiTurnoutSub: people who voted over the census of the open processes
admin.noneTallied: No process has been tallied yet.

census.title: Censuses
census.can: create censuses and import or edit the people who can vote.
census.none: There are no censuses yet. Create the first one so that a process can be prepared.
census.frozenSub: used by a scheduled or open process
census.noEditable: Create a new one for upcoming processes.
census.frozenHelp: A census used by a scheduled or open process cannot change until the process ends.

audit.title: Ballot box integrity
audit.can: check the ballot box record of each process and the administrative traceability. Read only.
audit.kpiClosedSub: with a ballot box record to verify
audit.neverDetail: Verify the event chain of the closed processes.
audit.secrecy: Vote events have no time and are never linked to who voted (ballot secrecy).
audit.none: There are no closed processes to verify yet.

censuses.title: Censuses
censuses.introManager: Create a census and add the people who can vote, by hand or by importing an Excel file (.xlsx).
censuses.introAdmin: Censuses of your organisation. Only the census manager can change them.
censuses.nameRequired: Enter the name of the census.

forbidden.title: No permission
forbidden.message: Your role does not give access to this section.

onboarding.title: First steps
onboarding.intro: This is how a vote is organized in VeriVoto. You can open this guide again at any time with “Quick guide”.

create.title: Create the process
create.text: In Processes, press “Create process” and fill in the 4 steps: details, dates, census and ballot. It is saved as a draft.

schedule.title: Review and schedule it
schedule.text: Open the process from Processes and press “Schedule”. If something is missing, the screen tells you what.

follow.title: Follow the vote
follow.text: It opens and closes by itself at the dates you set (there is no button to do it by hand). In Turnout you see how many people have voted.

results.title: Check the result
results.text: When it closes, the count is automatic. In Results you see the result and its fingerprint, and you can generate the minutes.

onboarding.note: Writing the texts in the default language is enough: the other language is translated automatically and you can correct it.

processForm.title: Create voting process
processForm.intro: The process is saved as a Draft until you schedule it.
processForm.defaultLanguage: Language in which you write the texts of the process
processForm.bilingualHelp: Write each text only once. When you leave each field it is translated into the other language; you can review the translation if you want.
processForm.translationFailed: Automatic translation is not available: write the other language or the same text will be saved in both.
processForm.visibility: When the vote ends, who will see the result?
processForm.censusOnly: Only the people in the census
processForm.censusOnlyHelp: They sign in with their personal link and code.
processForm.publicLinkHelp: Useful for open votes. The final hash is always public.
processForm.calendarHelp: Opening and closing happen automatically at these times (your browser time): they cannot be done by hand.
processForm.calendarExample: Example: opening today at 18:00 and closing tomorrow at 18:00. The opening must be later than the moment you schedule the process (leave at least 15 minutes) and the closing, later than the opening.
processForm.noCensuses: There are no censuses in your organization. Ask the census manager to create one.
processForm.onlyCensus: It is the only census of your organization, so it is already selected.
processForm.singleChoiceHelp: One list or option is chosen.
processForm.question: Question
processForm.yesNoFixed: The options «Yes», «No» and «Abstain» are created automatically in both languages.
processForm.notEditable: This process is no longer a draft: it cannot be edited.

created.title: Process created
created.message: «{{title}}» was saved as a Draft. Check it and schedule it when you are ready.

errors.titleRequired: Write the title in the default language.
errors.titleForDescription: If you write the description in this language, write the title too.
errors.closesAfter: Closing must be after opening (they cannot have the same time).
errors.opensFuture: Opening must be later than now. Choose a future time, for example in 15 minutes.
errors.questionRequired: Write the question in the default language.
errors.optionRequired: Write the option in the default language.

processForm.emailCodeHelp: When they open their personal link they receive a 6-digit code at the email of the voter list.
processForm.ssoHelp: They sign in with the account of the organization; its verified email must be the one of the voter list.
processForm.restored: We recovered what you were writing ({{time}}). It is already in the form: you can continue where you left off.
processForm.discardConfirm: Everything you had written will be deleted. Are you sure?

process.title: Lifecycle
process.readOnly: Your role can view the process but not change it.
process.automatic: Opening and closing are automatic at the set times: they cannot be done early by hand.
process.checksHelp: Scheduling freezes the census and sends the invitations. Every status change is recorded.

texts.title: Title and description
texts.ko: The other language is missing: edit the process and save; it will be translated automatically

calendar.title: Consistent calendar
calendar.ok: Opening is in the future and before closing
calendar.ko: Opening must be in the future and before closing: edit the calendar (for example, opening in 15 minutes)

ballot.title: Ballot defined
ballot.ok: Question and options in both languages
ballot.ko: The other language is missing in the question or options: edit the process and save; it will be translated automatically

scheduleConfirm.title: Schedule the process?
scheduleConfirm.message: The census will be frozen and the invitations sent. You will not be able to edit it afterwards.

process.scheduled: Process scheduled. It will open automatically at the set time.

what.DRAFT: Edit everything and schedule the process
what.SCHEDULED: Opens by itself at the set time; census and ballot frozen

process.noActions: There are no manual actions in this status: the process moves on by itself on the set dates.

census.title: Census
census.heading: Census · {{name}}
census.frozenHelp: Frozen census: a scheduled or open process uses it, so it cannot change until that process ends.
census.readOnly: Your role can view the census, not change it.
census.search: Search by name, email or ID
census.noPeople: The census has no people yet.

form.phoneHelp: Digits only, no spaces or + prefix.
form.added: {{name}} has been added to the census.

errors.email: Enter a valid email, for example name@ual.es.
errors.phone: The phone number only accepts digits (up to 15).
errors.institutionalId: The ID accepts 50 characters at most.

remove.title: Remove this person?
remove.message: {{name}} will no longer be in the census and will not receive invitations.
remove.done: {{name}} is no longer in the census.

import.columns: Your file must include at least the full name and the email of each person. Phone, institutional ID and language are optional.
import.rules: Use an Excel file (.xlsx), for example the template. Up to 5 MB and 50,000 people. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.idle: Choose a file: you will see how many people would be added, the duplicates and the lines with errors before anything is saved.
import.validatingHelp: We are checking the file and looking for duplicates. Nothing has been saved yet.
import.applyingHelp: Do not close this page until it finishes.

reason.EMAIL: the email is already in the census or repeated in the file
reason.INSTITUTIONAL_ID: the institutional ID is already in the census or repeated in the file

import.invalidHelp: Fix the file and select it again, or discard the lines with errors to import the rest.
import.readyHelp: Check the summary and confirm to save the new people. Duplicates are skipped.
import.nothingHelp: There are no new people to add.
import.discard: Discard lines with errors and import {{count}}
import.notApplied: The census changed since the validation; check the new summary.

errors.extension: That file is not an Excel file (.xlsx). Save it as «Excel Workbook (.xlsx)» or start from the example template.
errors.empty: The file is empty. Add at least the header row and one person.
errors.size: The file is larger than {{max}} MB. Split it into several files and import them one by one.
errors.generic: We could not check the file. Check your connection and try again.

template.title: Example template (Excel)
template.explain: It is an Excel file with one column per field, in this order: Full name, Email, Phone, Institutional ID and Language for messages. It includes an «Instructions» sheet.
template.languages: The phone number has digits only, no spaces or + prefix. In Language, choose Spanish or English from the list; if it is left empty, Spanish is used.
template.required: Columns marked with * are required. Delete the two example rows (grey and italic) before uploading the file.

import.exampleWarning: Lines {{lines}} have the example data of the template (such as maria.garcia@example.com). If they are not real people, delete them from the file and select it again; if you confirm, they will be added to the census.

picker.label: Process
picker.empty: There are no processes to show yet.

participation.title: Turnout panel
participation.empty: There are no scheduled processes yet.
participation.live: Updates automatically · last update {{seconds}} s ago
participation.byDayTitle: Cumulative turnout per day (% of the census)
participation.notOpen: Voting is not open yet: only the census is shown.
participation.lockTitle: Results per option are not shown until the tally.
participation.lockText: Here you only see how many people have voted, never what they voted. Turnout is counted per day, without hours, to protect the secrecy of the vote.

notifications.remindersTitle: Reminders to people who have not voted
notifications.remindersHelp: They go only to people on the voter list who have not voted yet, with a new personal link. You will see how many people received them, never who.
notifications.confirmNow: Send a reminder now to the {{count}} people who have not voted?
notifications.limit: You can have up to {{max}} reminders per process ({{used}} so far).
notifications.nobodyLeft: Everybody on the voter list has already voted.
notifications.onlyOpen: Reminders can only be sent while voting is open.
notifications.outOfPeriod: Choose a date and time from now on and before voting closes.
notifications.sentNow: Reminder on its way: it will be sent in a few seconds.
notifications.notNeededHelp: "Not needed": reminders for people who had already voted and emails that no longer made sense once voting closed.
notifications.failedTitle: Emails that could not be delivered
notifications.failedReminders: Also, {{count}} reminders could not be delivered. They are only counted: saying who they were for would reveal who has not voted.
notifications.loadError: The emails of the process could not be loaded. Please try again.

results.title: Results
results.empty: There are no closed processes yet.
results.exportError: The CSV could not be downloaded. Try again.
results.tallyingText: The ballot box is counting the votes and checking its log. You do not need to wait here: the result will appear in a few seconds.
results.tallyingStep1: Check of the ballot box log
results.tallyingStep3: Result stored and its hash published
results.publicText: Anyone with this link can see the result and check it.
results.censusOnlyText: This process does not publish the result with a public link. The hashes are public.
results.minutesText: They include process, calendar, census, turnout, result and hashes. Generated the first time and then the same file is always downloaded.
results.minutesError: The minutes could not be generated. Try again.

audit.title: Ballot box audit
audit.intro: Read only: the ballot box log cannot be edited. Votes appear without identity and without time.
audit.empty: There are no scheduled processes yet.
audit.neverText: Verify the log to check that nobody has altered it.
audit.okText: {{count}} events checked · no alteration found · last check on {{date}}
audit.badText: The check of {{date}} found alterations. An incident was recorded and the tally will not be published while it stays like this.

problem.HASH_MISMATCH: The event was changed: its data no longer produce its hash.
problem.BROKEN_LINK: The event does not link to the previous one (an event was inserted, deleted or reordered).
problem.SEQUENCE_GAP: A number is missing in the sequence of events.
problem.HEAD_MISMATCH: Events are missing at the end of the log.
problem.BALLOT_MISMATCH: The ballot is no longer the one fixed at opening.
problem.VOTE_COUNT_MISMATCH: Votes, receipts and vote events do not match.
problem.CLOSED_COUNT_MISMATCH: The closing does not match the number of votes recorded.
problem.FINAL_HASH_MISMATCH: The published final hash is not the hash of the closing.

audit.finalPending: The final hash will be published at closing ({{date}}).
audit.noEvents: The ballot box has no events yet: the first one is the opening.
audit.showing: Showing {{from}}–{{to}} of {{total}} events · votes are shown without identity or time

trace.title: Traceability
trace.intro: Administrative actions of your organization: who did what, on what and when. The record cannot be changed or deleted.
trace.none: There are no actions with these filters.

privacy.title: Data privacy (GDPR)
privacy.intro: Handle access and erasure requests of the people in the voter lists of your organization.
privacy.queryHelp: It searches every voter list of your organization.
privacy.name: Name
privacy.voteNote: The vote cannot be exported or erased per person: it is secret and not linked to their identity.
privacy.exportText: A machine-readable file (JSON) is generated with the personal data of this person, their participation and the emails we sent them.
privacy.exported: File downloaded. Give it to the person through a secure channel.
privacy.blocked: This person is on the voter list of {{processes}}, which is scheduled or open. You can erase their data when voting ends.
privacy.willAnonymize: In the voter lists a process already used ({{count}}), their data will be anonymized: votes, participation and the ballot box log are kept.
privacy.willDelete: In the voter lists no process used ({{count}}), their data will be deleted.
privacy.confirm: I confirm the erasure request of this person

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.intro: Keys let the systems of your organization (for example, the registry office or a website) read processes, participation and results through the API. They only read: they cannot see voter lists or personal data and cannot change anything.
apiKeys.name: Name (which system it is for)
apiKeys.limit: You can have up to {{max}} active keys ({{used}} so far).

scope.processes: Processes of your organization: list, details and status history.
scope.results: Tallied results, counted votes and CSV export.

apiKeys.scopeNot: It cannot see voter lists, personal data, the ballot box log or the traceability, nor download the minutes.
apiKeys.onlyOnce: Copy the secret now: it will not be shown again. If you lose it, revoke the key and create another one.
apiKeys.howTo: The system requests a token with these credentials (OAuth 2.0, client credentials) and sends it with every call. Each token lasts 5 minutes.
apiKeys.none: Your organization has no API keys yet.
apiKeys.confirmRevoke: Revoke? The system will lose access within minutes.

welcome.step1: We will email you a 6-digit code.
welcome.step2: You choose your option and review it before confirming.
welcome.step3: You get a receipt code to check that your vote is in the ballot box.
welcome.secret: Your vote is secret: nobody can know what you voted. You can vote only once.
welcome.step1Sso: You will sign in with your institutional account (the one of the email that received the invitation).

sso.title: Sign in with your institutional account
sso.text: In this vote we check who you are with the account of your organization. Use the account of the email that received the invitation.
sso.button: Sign in with your institutional account
sso.note: We will take you to the sign-in page of your organization and bring you back here. Your vote stays secret: the account only tells us it is you.
sso.failedTitle: We could not complete the sign-in
sso.failedText: Open the personal link of your email again and try once more.
sso.mismatch: The account you signed in with is not the one of this link. Use the account of the email that received the invitation. {{remaining}} attempts left.
sso.cancelled: You cancelled the sign-in. Try again whenever you want.
sso.invalid: We could not check your account. Please sign in again.

code.title: Access code
code.intro: To check that it is you, we will email you an access code.
code.sentTo: We have sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It expires in {{minutes}} minutes.
code.label: Access code
code.resendIn: You can ask for another code in {{time}}
code.wrong: The code is not correct. You have {{remaining}} attempts left.
code.expired: The code has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
code.tooSoon: Please wait a little before asking for another code.
code.mailFailed: We could not send the email. Please try again in a few minutes.

ballot.help: Choose one option. You can review it before voting.
ballot.blankHelp: It counts as participation but supports no option.
ballot.missing: You have not chosen an option yet.

review.title: Review your vote
review.notYet: You have not voted yet. Once you confirm, your vote cannot be changed.

receipt.title: Vote recorded
receipt.message: Thank you. Your vote is in the ballot box.
receipt.keep: Keep this code: it is shown only now. It lets you check that your vote is in the ballot box; it does not show what you voted.

notOpen.title: Voting is not open yet
notOpen.message: You can vote from {{opens}}. Open this link again then.

closed.title: Voting is closed
closed.message: The period ended on {{closes}}. Votes can no longer be cast. Once the tally is complete you can see the result here with this same link.

invalidLink.title: This link is not valid
invalidLink.message: Use the link in your latest invitation email. If you are not on the voter list, contact your organization.

expiredLink.title: The link has expired
expiredLink.message: Contact your organization to receive a new link.

locked.title: Access temporarily blocked
locked.message: Too many attempts. For your security, wait until {{until}} and try again.

alreadyVoted.title: You have already voted
alreadyVoted.messageOn: Your vote was recorded on {{day}}. You can vote only once.
alreadyVoted.message: Your vote is already recorded. You can vote only once.

sessionExpired.title: Your session has expired
sessionExpired.message: Your choice was not saved and you have not voted. Open the same link again.

notRecorded.title: Your vote was NOT recorded
notRecorded.message: The connection or the server failed. You can retry safely: two votes will never be recorded.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.message: We could not load the vote. Please try again in a few minutes.

verify.title: Check my receipt
verify.intro: Type or paste your receipt code to check that your vote is in the ballot box.
verify.label: Receipt code
verify.format: The code must have 64 characters from 0-9 and a-f.
verify.present: Your vote is in the ballot box.
verify.absent: We cannot find that code in this vote. Check that it is complete.
verify.error: We could not check it. Please try again.
verify.limits: The receipt proves that your vote is in the ballot box; it does not show or prove what you voted.

footer.secure: Secure connection · Your vote is secret

results.readyText: Voting closed on {{closes}} and the tally is complete. To see the result, confirm it is you with a code we will send to your email.
results.secret: The result does not show what each person voted.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.message: This address does not exist. Check the link or go back to the start.
notFound.voterMessage: This address does not exist. If you are going to vote, use the personal link you received by email.
notFound.consoleLink: Do you manage elections? Sign in to the console

results.finalHash: Final hash of the ballot box

verify.okText: Your browser recomputed the count from the published votes and it matches the result.
verify.badText: Recomputed from the published votes it does not match. Tell the organisation.
verify.errorText: The published votes could not be obtained. Try again later.
verify.limits: Published votes only carry a random identifier and the option: they cannot be linked to anyone or to any receipt.

publicResults.notFoundText: This link does not exist or the result has not been published yet. Results appear after the tally.
publicResults.errorTitle: The results could not be loaded
